_about: Presentation data for the Pokemon from #019 on (creature_rig.gd): family and stance, size (height in m as baked, scale a tweak on top), sex variants, the act names mood() takes (the battle maps moves to these), idle fidget weights, gait numbers and face cells.

_schema.family: legged | serpent | bird (how it moves; creature_rig.gd)
_schema.height: baked height (m, as tools/native/bake_creatures.mjs sets it)
_schema.scale: a size tweak on top (1 = as baked)
_schema.variants: {key: what differs}: Creature.make(id, key) loads creatures/<id>_<key>.glb
_schema.acts: the names mood() takes (the battle maps moves to them)
_schema.gait: {walk_v, run_v, run_gait (trot|bound|gallop), stride, run_stride, duty, run_duty, bob, run_bob, sway, waddle, step_h, spine_flex, pitch_run, quad_run, quad_pitch, quad_crouch, quad_tail, look_k, darty, ear_flick, breath, arm_swing, head_bob, crouch_h, lie, tail_lift, tail_sway, tail_lag, stance_w}
_schema.tail_shape: per tail bone, its rest lift (rad)
_schema.jaw_rest / jaw_open: the jaw shut (rad, from the rip) and how far it opens
_schema.look_amp / head_level: how far the head turns / is kept level
_schema.eyes / mouths: {expression: [u, v]} offsets in the face sheets where a rip lays them out differently (open, angry, half, happy, closed, sad, squeeze, extra / closed, open, smile, frown, wide, pout, flat)
_schema.materials: {texture name (bodya1, eye1, mouth1 ..) or * for all: {tint: [r, g, b] a multiply, brightness: 1, saturation: 1 (about grey), texture: res:// path of another image, blend: opaque | cutout, alpha_cut: 0.5 (cutout), masks: [{rect: [u0, v0, u1, v1] of the sheet, tint: [r, g, b]}] (two at most)}}
_schema.cheek / horn: rest points (skeleton space, m) of a Pikachu cheek (the left) / a Nido horn tip
_schema.radius, rise_base, rise_len, rise_angle,: a serpent: body radius, how tall and how much of it rises, the coil, the slither, the hood bones
_schema.fold: Fearow: the folded wing (sw, el, e, e2, h, tw)

variants.f: tail tip without the bolt's point
